title:
This type represents a module for scaling risk scores. Scaling techniques are important for normalizing
risk scores or other values into a comparable range, ensuring that they can be effectively used for
downstream modeling, interpretation, and alerting purposes.

This type is part of the broader `ReliabilityRiskMl` suite, which deals with the analysis and prediction
of risk scores in various contexts.
name: ReliabilityRiskMl.RiskScoreScaling
